verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a bulk data export or account-exit path. The only signs of getting data out are piecemeal: the Disputes API lets you retrieve dispute information, and webhooks and payment responses can carry risk details such as triggered rules and case-management status. Missing for 10: a documented full-data export (risk profiles, custom rules, risk lists, case history), named open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON dumps), data-portability or offboarding guidance, and independent corroboration.
